projection: Equidistant Cylindrical (Plate Carree), standard parallel 18.4663 N, central meridian 0
name: Jezero_Crater_Projection
latitude_type: Planetocentric (identical to planetographic on a sphere)
vertical_reference: DEM heights relative to the Mars 2000 sphere / areoid convention used by the USGS product (USGS states the CTX DEMs were vertically tied to MOLA). Not independently re-verified here.
scale_note: In eqc, east-west scale is exact only at 18.4663 N; within this DEM (17.58-19.29 N) the E-W scale factor is within about +/-1%. Slope uses the nominal 20 m spacing (error < ~1% in gradient). Areas are given both planar-projected and on the sphere (geodesic).
zones_crs: Same as DEM (verified: identical WKT in jezero_dataset_metadata.json; coordinates fall within DEM extent)
